# Python — Latest Stable Release & Python 3.0 Release Year

## Latest stable release

- **Version:** Python **3.14.8**
- **Release date:** **September 30, 2026** (30 Sep 2026)
- 3.14 is the current bugfix (stable) series; 3.15 is only a pre-release with a planned first release on 2026-10-01.

## Year Python 3.0 was released

- Python 3.0.0 was released on **December 3, 2008** → year **2008**.

## Sources

- https://www.python.org/downloads/ — lists "Download Python 3.14.8" as the latest version, release list showing "Python 3.14.8, Sept. 30, 2026" and "Python 3.0.0, Dec. 3, 2008"
- https://endoflife.date/python — Python release/support table confirming 3.14.8 (30 Sep 2026) and 3.0 (03 Dec 2008)

text:
Done. Findings (from python.org and endoflife.date):

- **Latest stable release:** Python **3.14.8**, released **September 30, 2026** (3.14 is the current stable bugfix series; 3.15 is still pre-release).
- **Python 3.0 release year:** **2008** (3.0.0 was released December 3, 2008).

`answer.md` is written at the workspace root with both answers and the source URLs. Note: web search was unavailable (search service refused), so I fetched the python.org downloads page and endoflife.date directly instead — both agree on the facts above.
